en: Color postcard reproducing a Renaissance painting of the biblical Return of the Prodigal Son by Bernardino Licinio: figures in rich 16th‑century dress gathered in a courtyard with arcades and a landscape beyond. The reverse has museum credit lines in Romanian, French, German, and English, a Romanian stamp (Beethoven 1770–1970), and a handwritten French poem with an address in Romania.
